comments.author: StalkingKraken89
comments.content: OMG! Doodle Cricket is so addictive! The simple gameplay and those cute characters are really charming. Gotta beat my high score now!

comments.author: SavageKATANA_X
comments.content: This game is pure fun. The doodle style is just fantastic, and I love how easy it is to pick up and play Doodle Cricket. Still, I am terrible at it, haha!

comments.author: Witcher4Lyfe
comments.content: Doodle Cricket is my daily dose. I just love the simple yet intense gameplay. What's not to love? It is great for kids and adults.

comments.author: NoobMaster9000
comments.content: Geez, I'm hooked to Doodle Cricket! The scoring system is so easy to get, but getting a good score is very cool! You gotta try it.

comments.author: xX_DarkAura_Xx
comments.content: This game is pure genius! The light-weight design of Doodle Cricket is perfect, it also has very cool game modes. Highly recommend it.

comments.author: PhantomPhoenix42
comments.content: I really love Doodle Cricket! It is great when I want to waste some time. The simple rules are easy to learn!

comments.author: NeonBroadsword_X
comments.content: Doodle Cricket's visual style is awesome. It's simple, fun and also challenging. The game is good to go when you do not want a big game!

comments.author: LagWarriorXX
